requirements.details: A recognized Diploma in Education plus four MSCE/equivalent credit subjects including English and other language subjects; the examples are Chichewa and French. The table lists full-time face-to-face delivery and Year 3 entry, subject to the common mature-entry framework.

requirements.label: Philosophy-major certificate/diploma exception
requirements.details: For the Philosophy major, the row names a Philosophy certificate for Year 2 or a Philosophy diploma for Year 3, plus six MSCE/equivalent credits including English. The certificate option does not fit the generic diploma/post-diploma-work baseline without clarification; confirm the exception rather than imposing the ordinary four-credit Humanities route or promising a waiver.

requirements.details: Six MSCE/equivalent credits including English and Mathematics, plus a relevant diploma. requirements.label: Psychology: prior-bachelor alternative
requirements.details: The row also considers holders of another bachelor degree who work in a psychology-related field. It does not clearly reconcile that alternative with the general diploma/post-diploma experience baseline or guarantee a specific entry year. Confirm the applicable evidence and route with admissions; do not invent an extra diploma requirement for every bachelor holder.

requirements.label: Mature-entry cycle requires confirmation
requirements.details: The official February 2026 announcement and specification headers identify 2026/2027, but the specification opening sentence says 2025/2026. The linked form likewise has 2026/2027 on its first pages and 2025/2026 on its final checklist. These conflicting labels do not justify assigning all requirements to a confirmed current cycle.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 1; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Shared mature-entry school-credit baseline
requirements.details: The specification requires at least four MSCE/equivalent O-level credit passes including English, with six credits needed for some programmes and additional named subjects in the programme rows. Four is not a universal sufficient subject count.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 1; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Standard diploma pathway
requirements.details: The standard framework accepts a University of Malawi diploma, a relevant diploma from its affiliated institutions, or an equivalent diploma from a recognized higher-learning institution. The named Philosophy/Library certificate and Psychology bachelor alternatives need their own applicability checks.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 2; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Standard post-diploma relevant work experience
requirements.details: The standard diploma pathway calls for at least two years of relevant work after the diploma, in a field related to the chosen programme. Programme-specific stronger requirements remain additional; this is not an age cutoff or a universal promise that two years is sufficient for every programme.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 2; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Published withdrawal/current-registration exclusions
requirements.details: The specification excludes candidates withdrawn on academic grounds from University of Malawi or another public university, and those already registered at either as residential, non-residential or mature-entry students. This is the stated rule of this mature-entry document, not a global permanent ban inferred for every university application scheme.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 17; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Creative Arts row has a stronger experience condition
requirements.details: The specification Creative Arts row requires at least four years of work in related Arts/Drama/Film/Music/Fashion fields, a related diploma and four school credits including English, with Year 3 full-time entry. Its printed code BAMUS differs from the earlier economic call Creative Arts code, so catalogue linkage needs confirmation. The general two-year baseline must not replace this stronger row.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 17; BAMUS; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Academic evidence: original-versus-copy wording
requirements.details: The specification/checklist requests relevant qualification/transcript copies certified by a recognized Commissioner of Oaths. Form page 1 additionally requests original academic transcripts and certified award/result copies, while its final checklist again describes certified copies. Confirm which originals must actually be supplied; do not treat a scan as an explicitly accepted substitute or assume every original award must be surrendered.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry application form, PDF page 1, 3; mixed 2026/27 and 2025/26 footers

requirements.label: CV with three traceable referees
requirements.details: Provide a CV giving names and contact details for three traceable referees. This is a CV referee-contact requirement, not a requirement for three separate recommendation letters.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 18; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Employer letters and employment record
requirements.details: Attach official reference letters from current/previous employers proving the relevant work experience. The form asks for a reference from each listed employer, and the checklist requests evidence of at least two work years; specific programme rules may be stronger. Start the employment record with the most recent employer.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry application form, PDF page 2–3; mixed 2026/27 and 2025/26 footers

requirements.label: Original evidence of available training funds
requirements.details: Include original evidence of available training funds, such as an official sponsorship letter or the applicant bank statements. The mature application-package section does not set a universal minimum bank balance.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 18; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Mature application fee and named deposit evidence
requirements.details: The mature scheme lists a non-refundable fee of MWK 25,000 for Malawian applicants or USD 35 for international applicants. Attach the deposit-slip copy bearing the applicant name and paid amount. These are application fees rather than tuition; the document does not confirm a future cycle charge.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry specification, PDF page 17–18; inconsistent cycle labels

requirements.label: Complete form, programme/mode choice and submission
requirements.details: Complete the form in block letters, specify the programme name/code and preferred delivery mode, attach the requested passport-size photo and signed declaration, and send the complete package to the Registrar, University of Malawi, P.O. Box 280, Zomba, attention Academic Office. The form says not to submit to a constituent/affiliate college; incomplete packages are not processed.

source.title: Malawi mature-entry application form, PDF page 1–3; mixed 2026/27 and 2025/26 footers

requirements.label: Stated mature-entry deadline is past
requirements.details: The specification and form state Friday, 31 July 2026 as the receiving deadline, already past when checked on 4 November 2026. Mixed academic-year labels do not establish a reopened window, extension or new 2027 closing date.
